note: Planting on foot (D1a; Matt, October 24, 2026; src/world/sowing). All planting is the walker's: the seed tin and the gift spot sit on the walker's bar, each one drawn icon that opens a small menu of drawn icons above it. tin.endless: the only seeds that live in the tin for good (reeds, water lilies and sea thrift set up the first pond and shore); every other plant is deliberate (gathered seed, D1b; cuttings; gifts). gifts: what a species' gift puts on the gift spot, and how many there are to place: `unlock` is the path in the saved unlocks that gives it (seeds.pondweed, the minnows'; raft, the turtles'), `place` says what a placing makes (a plant of `species`, or a raft), `count` how many. ring: the pencil ring that follows the pointer while something is in hand, radiusM on the ground, re-read at most checkHz times a second; ink and faint its strokes' opacity, crossM the arms of the cross on a spot that will not do. toss: within nearM of the walker a seed drops along a short dotted line (nearS), further it flies on a dotted arc whose top rises arcRise of the distance (at least arcMinM, at most arcMaxM) over flightPerM seconds a meter (between flightS), and the line fades over fadeS once the seed lands. puff: a puff of soil on land (r grows from rM[0] to rM[1] over s); splash: rings on water (a little one near you, rings of them further out). flickS: when in the sow gesture the seed leaves the hand. net: setting the net on foot: the walker walks to within reachM of the clicked spot, then kneels and sets it over standS seconds (the netSet gesture). words: the lines and hover labels.
p2gNote: Planting from below (P2g, Matt's plan page, October 25, 2026; src/world/sowing). Everything is planted from the bar: the seed tin's menu also holds the pack's saved seed ('<species>.seed', one sowing a handful, its pouch drawn as full as it is), its seed balls ('<species>.ball', one ball a handful) and its lifted clumps and withies. Seed and balls are tossed with the sow flick. A ball holds ball.seeds seeds and lands as a small cluster round the spot (spreadShare of the species' spacing from the middle), each taking on ground down to ball.minSuit (a bare seed needs 0.2). A clump or a withy: the walker walks to within set.reachM, kneels and sets it (the setClump gesture, set.setS s) or pushes the withy in (pushIn, set.pushS s). A clump goes in at the size it was lifted; a withy roots as a young grey willow (cutting.size) under willow's own ground rule and its island cap. lift: the plants a shovel can lift whole (the plant card's Lift, the liftClump act), with maxSize where a bush or tree is only lifted young; reachM, how close you stand. goodStart: setting a clump or a cutting with kelp, wrack or ash in the pack lays one handful in the hole first (the first that the pack holds, in order): it starts bonus bigger. Every ring keeps D1a's rule.

words.giftsEmpty: Nothing waiting. Gifts from the island come here.
words.firstSow: Plants spread on their own once they settle. Sow a few, and watch where they go.

placed.raft: The raft floats on the pond.

words.netWalk: Walking out to set the net.
words.netGone: The tide has moved; the net can't go there now.
words.setWalk: Walking over to set it in.
words.setGone: The ground there has changed; it can't go in now.
words.lifted: It comes up whole on the blade. Its roots are bare: set it in the ground to keep it.
words.liftNoShovel: Lifting a plant whole wants a shovel.
words.liftTooBig: Too big to lift now. Young, it would have come up whole.
words.liftFull: No pouch free for a clump. A clump fills a whole pouch.
words.goodStart: You lay a handful of {kind} in the hole first. It will start a little stronger.
words.rooted: Pushed into the damp ground, the withy will root.
